title: Montgomery's thanks and goodbye
summary: Montgomery thanks Bushell and the recording ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Garvin, I'd like to just and a little to what you're saying now, and express myself and mention one thing in particular. What a pleasure it's been forme just to meet and to know you. You've been a great inspiration for me and I've got a strong feeling you will be for the whole community with an attitude such as yours about the world of music. It's very inspiring just having you here in Las Vegas with us. It's been more of a pleasure for me to have the opportunity to chat and listen to some of your experiences about jazz music over the past 60 years. It's just beautiful. Thank you.
